Second VERDANT governance review to evaluate the first full month with six facilities, review monitoring, security and temporal quality, and decide whether the expanded pilot should continue through the autumn.

Andrés Beltrán: Expansion began on 10 August. Today we review a full month and decide whether it should continue without changes.
Sergio Vidal: Sixty-three requests were recorded: 59 approved and four rejected. None requested export of 15-minute data. There were two retention alerts, both resolved before expiry.
Nuria Castaño: Automatic secret rotation and certificate revocation passed testing. No unauthorized access was detected.
Inés Ferrer: Missing data affected 3.8 percent of intervals. Dynamic suppression removed 4.6 percent; daily indicators remained stable within a 1.2 percent margin.
Carmen Rey: SolCentro considers the operational load manageable. Reviewing local-processing outputs still requires about two hours per run.
Héctor Molina: There is no material increase in risk. I recommend retaining six facilities and treating any further expansion as a new scope amendment.
Bruno Silva: The international partner can continue through November under the same retention and non-redistribution conditions.
Javier Ortega: The decision must retain current controls and specify that it does not automatically authorize new facilities.
Andrés Beltrán: Continuation with six facilities through 30 November is approved. No further expansion is authorized. Closure of this phase will be reviewed on 6 October and final evaluation in November.
